turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My puppy bites my hands constantly. Her teeth are like needles.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Puppy teeth are vicious. Biting is normal at that age, she's exploring and teething, but you can teach her to be gentle.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How? She thinks it's a game.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: When she bites, stop playing immediately and go still. Then offer a toy she's allowed to chew instead.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And if she goes for my ankles?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Same thing. Freeze, be boring, then redirect to a tug toy. Running away makes it more exciting.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My kids keep squealing and running.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Teach them to be trees, stand still with arms folded. It's hard for kids, but it works fast if everyone does it.
